newsitem.title: UK: Strong European vgo prices unsettle buyers.
newsitem.headline: Strong European vgo prices unsettle buyers.

text.p: European vaccum gas oil prices were sharply higher on Wednesday compared with the end of last week, boosted by booming crude levels. But the higher prices slowed buying interest, pariticularly for the well-supplied low sulphur sector.
A high sulphur barge was sold at $163 fob ARA. The material was understood to be Russian ex-tank headed into Germany.
Low sulphur product built up on easier U.S. demand due to several crackers being down and muted interest in NWE.
Poor water levels in the Rhine, which had been constraining business earlier in the week, was not cited as a major impediment.
